subject.title: fix(agents): add tool-use terminal continuation for codex app-server toolUse stops

question: Must this recovery attempt be technically incapable of dispatching tools, or is a prompt-only instruction not to repeat side effects acceptable?
rationale: The new branch intentionally bypasses the existing side-effect replay guard, while the inspected diff does not enforce tool suppression and direct sibling Codex-source verification was unavailable.

options.title: Enforce a no-tools continuation
options.body: Add a runtime or harness-owned continuation mode that can produce final text but cannot dispatch tools, then cover committed-delivery and live Codex behavior.

options.title: Accept prompt-only suppression
options.body: Merge with the explicit understanding that the model may disregard the instruction and repeat a side-effectful tool call.

recommendation.title: Enforce a no-tools continuation
recommendation.body: Add a runtime or harness-owned continuation mode that can produce final text but cannot dispatch tools, then cover committed-delivery and live Codex behavior.
